paite: Israel kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash kum nih alal kum in Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah alal pan hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Amaziah / (2 Kro 25.1-24)

paite: Alal pat tung in kum sawmnih-le-nga a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnih-le-kua alal a; anu min Jehoadan, Jerusalem mi ahi.
TOUPA mitmuh in thil dik ahih a, himahleh apu David zaw apha kei; apa Joash thilhih bang ahih sam hi.
Mun sangte lakmang ahi tuan kei a, mun sangte ah mite akithoih lai ua gimlim ahal lai uhi.
Akhut a lalgam ahong kiptak in hichi ahong hi a, apa, kumpipa thatmi ama sikhate athat hi.

Himahleh huai tualthat mite tate athat kei hi. Mosi Dan Bu a, "Tate ziak in pate hihlup ding ahi kei a, pate ziak in leng tate hihlup ding ahi sam kei, michih amau khelhna ziak in asi ding uh," chi a TOUPA thupiak gelh ahih bang in.
Edomte chi phaizang ah singkhat athat a, Selah khua asual a, ala a, amin ding in Joktheel asa a, tuni tan in hiai ahi lai hi.
Huchi in Amaziah in Israel kumpipa Jehu tapa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash kiang ah, hong kuan in, kimaituah ni, chi in mi asawl hi.

Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Judah kumpipa Amaziah kiang ah, "Lebanon tang a ling in Lebanon tang a sidar sing kiang ah, na tanu ka tapa zi ding in neisak dih ve, chi in athukhak a; Lebanon tang a gamsa ahong pai a, huai ling ahong tuanpuk hi.

Nang Edomte na zou ngei a, na lungtang ahong kisathei hi; na kisaktheihna ompih maimai in; nang leh Judah nangawn tan a siatna, nang a dia hoih lou ding thil bang ding a khoihkhe ding na hia?" chi in adawng hi.
Himahleh Amaziah in ana ngaikhe nuam kei a; huchi in Israel kumpipa Jehoash va hohtou in ava douta hi. Judah kumpipa Amaziah toh Judah gam Beth-shemesh ah ava kimaituahta uhi.
Judah bel Israelte ma ah azahlakta a; michih amau inn chiat ah ataikekta uh.

Israel kumpipa Jehoash in Judah kumpipa Ahaziah tapa Joash tapa Amaziah Beth-shemesh ah aman a, Jerusalem ah apaipih a, Jerusalem kulh, Ephraim kongpi a pan kulh ning kongpi pha in tong zali ahihchim hi.
TOUPA' inn leh kumpipa' inn a gou koihkhawmna a dangka-eng leh dangka leh tui-um belsuan om tengteng ala a, thuchiam tangtunna dia mat a om mite toh, huchi in Samaria kholam ah apai nawnta hi.
Huchi in Jehoash thilhih tanchin dangte, athilhihtheihdante, Judah kumpipa Amaziah adou thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Huchi in Jehoash api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmu a, Samaria ah Israel kumpipate lak ah avui ua; asik in atapa Jeroboam alalta hi.
Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah Israel kumpipa Jehoahaz tapa Jehoash sih nung in kum sawm-le- nga adam lai hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Amaziah Sihna / (2 Kro 25.25-28)

paite: Huchi in Amaziah tanchin dangte Judah kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Jerusalem ah amah aguksawm ua; huchi in Lakish ah mi adelhsak ua, huai ah athatta uhi.
Aluang sakol in apaipih ua, api-le-pute lak ah David khopi Jerusalem ah avui uhi.
Judah mi tengteng in kum sawm leh kum guk a upa, Azariah api ua, apa Amaziah sik in kumpipa in abawl uhi.
Ama'n Elath khua abawlhoih nawn in Judah gam ah apangsak nawn a; huai nung in kumpipa api-le-pute kiang ah a-ihmuta hi.
Judah kumpipa Joash tapa Amaziah kum sawm-le-nga alal kum in Israel kumpipa Jehoash tapa Jeroboam Samaria ah alal pan a, kum sawmli-le-khat alal hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa Jeroboam Nihna

paite: TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoih lou ahih a; Israelte thil ahihkhialsak a, Nebat tapa Jeroboam khelhna tengteng apaisan kei hi.
TOUPA, Israelte Pathian in asikha, Gath hepher mi Amittai tapa zawlnei Jonah zang a athugen bang in, Hamath lutna a pan Arabah Tuipi pha in Israel gam ah apangsak nawn hi.
TOUPA'N Israelte haksatna a thupi mahmah chih lah athei ngal a; sal hi in noplen hitaleh athuakdan uh akibang a; Israelte panpih ding kuamah om sam kei hi.
TOUPA'N Israel min van nuai ah achimitsak zenzen ding chih ahihleh agen kei him a; Jehoash tapa Jeroboam zang in ahondam zawta hi.

Huchi in Jeroboam tanchin dangte, athilhih tengtengte, athilhihtheihdante, agaldou thute, tuma lam in Judah gam tan hi gige Damaskas leh Hamath khua Israelte a dia ana laksak nawn thute Israel kumpipate khangthubute ah gelh ahi kei maw?
Jeroboam api leh pu, Israel kumpipate kiang ah a-ihmu samta a; huchi in atapa Zakariah asik in alalta hi.
